items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: we give it to Renee and Renee made the arrangement and we recorded it.

ctx.x: Ah - ha, so what do you remember about that time period when Rene came in and Joe Loco was gone?

Well, imagine! There was ahh - the band changed because Rene being a very talented arranger, know, in a way that he was better than anybody. He just went to the bottome of the Cuban music and he was arranging for the best in Cuba. Julio Cuevas - that he was with Cascarita - a great singer, Cuban singer, was singing with him and he was arranging for Cascarita; so he had all the detail that we had to explain to the American arranger here. To Renee, we didn't have to say anything. We used to give him the lead sheet…
Okay, who was Rene playing with when you sent for him?
